AC11 gate leniency (not wrong, worth knowing): the auditor counts a hit when ANY luminance peak lies within 1 px (not id-specific), and the count window 5,000-9,100 is wide. 8,107 detected of 8,773 unique predicted V<6.5 stars (92%) is the real detection rate. The 1.5 px positive control fails hard (0/93), so predicted positions are sub-pixel accurate in x; the gate can fail.

main.gd _capture_bright_audit computes V from custom[4k+1] (E_v at Sol) and direction from pos - ship; that is correct only at rest at the origin, which is where it is called (target == 0.0). A comment states 'at rest' but nothing asserts ship == 0.
